## Invitations

During the reporting period, 1514 invitations were issued across the outreach activity. Attendance was recorded for 280 people, giving an attendance rate of 18.5. The figures provide a straightforward summary of the invitation and attendance position for the quarter. They also provide a basis for reviewing how invitations were received and where further contact may be appropriate.

The attendance information should be considered alongside the follow-up arrangements used by staff. People who did not attend are identified for further contact, so that missed appointments can be followed up and opportunities to engage are not overlooked. This remains part of the ongoing outreach work.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS: the recorded SMS total was 0. No reminder messages were recorded, with the reminder total also 0. Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments. This contact is intended to maintain communication with those who did not attend and to support continued engagement with the service.

Prepared by G. Evans.
